name: Agency Bodyguard
Text: Disrupt: Exhaust Agency Bodyguard to cancel 1 wound dealt to a unique character.

name: Ancient Zoog
Text: Response: After you drain a domain to which Ancient Zoog is attached as a resource, unattach Ancient Zoog from that domain and attach it to a non-ZOOG character. (Counts as an ATTACHMENT ZOOG support card with the text: "Attached character gains the DREAMER subtype and $.")

name: Arcane Translation
Text: Disrupt: Play when you would draw cards from your deck. Instead of drawing cards from your deck, draw the same number of cards from the top of your discard pile. Then, place Arcane Translation at the bottom of your deck.

name: Ascension to Zura
Text: Action: Discard a wound token from an exhausted GUG character you control to ready that character.

name: Assist Dreamer
Text: If it is NIGHT, reduce the cost to play Assist Dreamer by 2. Action: Choose and ready a unique character. Until the end of the phase, that character gains the DREAMER subtype and $ $ $.

name: Back From the Dead
Text: Play only if it is NIGHT. Action: Choose a unique non-ANCIENT ONE character in any discard pile, and put it into play under your control with Back From the Dead attached. (Counts as an ATTACHMENT Support card with the text: "If Back From the Dead leaves play or if it becomes DAY, sacrifice attached character.")

name: Basilisk
Text: Forced Response: At the end of your turn. deal 2 wounds to all other characters you control or sacrifice Basilisk.

name: Behind Bars
Text: Action: Choose a character. Until the end of the phase, that character cannot commit to stories.

name: Beings of Ib
Text: Lower the cost to play Bokrug by 1 (to a minimum of 1). If you control a single ANCIENT ONE character, count its skill and icons at any story to which Beings of Ib is committed.

name: Blasphemous Dreams
Text: If it is NIGHT, reduce the cost to play Blasphemous Dreams by 2. Action: Ready a DREAMER character you control to choose and exhaust a non-DREAMER character.

name: Cerenerian Deep One
Text: Reduce the cost to play Cerenerian Deep One ny 1 for each DREAMLANDS support card you control.

name: City of Gugs
Subtitle: Beneath the Earth
Text: If it is DAY, Gug characters you control gain TOUGHNESS +1.

name: Clover Club Cardroom
Subtitle: Parlor of Higher Stakes
Text: Response: After a player wins a story card, sacrifice Clover Club Cardroom to have each player shuffle his hand back into his deck. Then, each player draws 6 cards.

name: Clover Club Deck
Text: Attach to a character you control. Action: Exhaust Clover Club Deck and pay 2 to look at an opponent's hand. Choose and discard one card from that hand. Then, that player draws one card.

name: Clover Club Executive
Text: Forced Response: After Clove Club Executive enters play, the player with the most cards in hand must randomly discard 2 cards from his hand. (In case of tie, no cards are discarded.)

name: Clover Club Regular
Text: Opponents play with the top card if their deck revealed. Response: After an opponent places a success token at a story, that player draws one card.

name: Cryptic Writings
Text: Attach to a non-ANCIENT ONE character. Attached character cannot trigger its effects.

name: Curious Zoog
Text: Response: After you drain a domain to wich Curious Zoog is attached as a resource, unattach Curious Zoog from that domain and return it to your hand to look at the top card of each player's deck. You may discard those cards or put them back on top of their owner's decks.

name: Curse of Darkness
Text: Disrupt: Cancel the effects of a DAY card just played. Then, shuffle that card back into its owner's deck.

name: Dark Contagion
Text: Attach to a character. Response: After a > character you control is wounded, wound attached character.

name: Dark Quagmire
Text: Attach Dark Quagmire to a story card. Dark Quagmire cannot be chosen as the only target of a triggered effect. At the beginning of each player's story phase, that player must remove one of his success tokens from attached story.

name: Day of the Deep Ones
Text: Action: Sacrifice one DEEP ONE character to destroy all DAY cards in play. Then, attach Day of the Deep Ones to a DEEP ONE character. Counts as an ATTACHMENT Support card with the text:"NIGHT. It is NIGHT."

name: Daybreak!
Text: Action: Destroy all NIGHT cards in play and attach Daybreak! to a story card. (Counts as an ENVIRONMENT support card with the text: "DAY. It is DAY. @ struggles do not resolve at this story.")

name: Devolution
Text: Action: Choose an opponent's character. That opponent must choose and exhaust another character he or she controls. Then, wound the character with the lower skill.

name: Dhole Ant-Lion
Text: Dhole Ant-Lion does not exhaust to commit to story cards if it has no wounds. Force Response: At the end of each story phase, sacrifice 1 character you control or wound Dhole Ant-Lion.

name: Dhole Attack!
Text: Action: Choose and destroy a LOCATION support card. Then, put Dhole Attack! into play as a MONSTER character with 3 skill and @ @ # #. At the end of the phase, sacrifice Dhole Attack.

name: Dhole Tunnel
Text: Action: Sacrifice Dhole Tunnel to choose a story card. Until the end of the phase, characters do not exhaust to commit to that story.

name: Dream Dagger
Text: Attach to a character you control. Attached character gains #. (@ # # $ instead if attached character is a DREAMER). Action: Pay 1 to unattach Dream Dagger, and attach it to a different character you control.

name: Dream Diary
Text: Attach to a character you control. Attached character gains the DREAMER subtype. If attached character is a unique character, it does not exhaust to commit to stories.

name: Dream Parasite
Text: Response: After a Forced Response is triggered, sacrifice Dream Parasite to trigger that Forced Response again.

name: Dreaming of the Past
Text: Attach to a story card. Disrupt: If an opponent would claim his fifth success token on this story, place Dreaming of the Past on the bottom of your deck to prevent that success token from being claimed.

name: Dreamlands Eclipse
Text: The player who controls the fewest DREAMLANDS support cards must play with the top card of his deck revealed.

name: Dreamlands Fanatic
Text: Response: After an opponent's character leaves play, put Dreamlands Fanatic into play from your hand.

name: Dreamlands Scholar
Text: Action: Pay 1 and exhaust a DREAMER character to look at the top 3 cards pf your deck. Put 1 of those cards in your hand, and the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Dreamlands Wanderer
Text: After Dreamlands Wanderer comes into play, destroy all DAY cards. Action: Pay 2 to put Dreamlands Wanderer into play from your hand, If Dreamlands Wanderer is still in play at the end of the phase, sacrifice it.

name: Dreamlore Documents
Text: Attach to a character you control. Action: Exhaust Dreamlore Documents to choose one subtype other than DREAMER or DREAMLANDS. Until the end of the phase, cards of the chosen subtype cost an additional 2 to play from their owner's hand.

name: Dreams Within Dreams
Text: Action: Choose a non-conspiracy story card in play, and exchange that story card with a non-conspiracy story card in your won story pile. (Any success tokens remain in place at the newly placed story card.)

name: Enraged Gug
Text: Response: After Enraged Gug is wounded, choose and wound one character with a # icon.

name: Everlasting Night
Text: Raise the cost for opponents to play DAY cards by 1. Action: Exhaust Everlasting Night to reduce the cost of the next NIGHT card you play this phase by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

name: Flood Lights
Text: Raise the cost for opponents to play NIGHT cards by 1. Action: Exhaust Flood Lights to reduce the cost of the next DAY card you play this phase by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

name: Forcibly Removed
Text: Action: Look at one opponent's hand and discard up to 2 non-unique character cards from that hand. Then, that player draws a card for each character discarded in this manner.

name: Furtive Zoog
Text: If it is DAY, Furtive Zoog gains %. If it is NIGHT, Furtive Zoog gains @. Response: After you drain a domain to which Furtive Zoog is attached as a resource, unattach Furtive Zoog from that domain and put it into play.

name: Ghoul Spawn
Text: Action: Sacrifice Ghoul Spawn to put one GHOUL character into play from your hand. Use this effect only if it is NIGHT.

name: Ghoulish Hag
Text: If it is DAY, sacrifice Ghoulish Hag. If it is NIGHT, Ghoulish Hag can be played from your discard pile as it if were in your hand.

name: Ghoulish Predator
Text: Ghoulish Predator cannot commit to stories while it is DAY.

name: Great Stone Circle
Text: If it is NIGHT, resolve all # struggles before all @ struggles at any story to which a GUG characte is committed.

name: Gregory Gry
Subtitle: Muckraker
Text: If it is DAY, Gregory Gry gains WILLPOWER and TOUGHNESS +2. If there are no DREAMER characters in play, Gregory Gry gains "Action: Pay 1 to ready Greagory Gry."

name: Gregory Gry
Subtitle: Shadow of his Former Self
Text: Action: Exhaust Gregory Gry to shuffle the top 2 cards of any discard pile back into their owner's deck.

name: Guardian of the Key
Text: Disrupt: Exhaust Guardian of the Key to cancel 1 effect that chooses a support card as a target.

name: Guardian Pillar
Text: If you control more DREAMLANDS support cards than any opponent, you may exhaust Guardian Pillar to commit it to a story as a character with 4 skill, @ # # #, and INVULNERABILITY.

name: Gug Sentinel
Text: Response: After Gug Sentinel is wounded, choose and exhaust 1 opponent's character.

name: Halflings of D'haz
Text: Halflings of D'haz can only commit to stories on your turn. The loser of any # struggle in which Halflings of D'haz participated must receive an additional wound for each icon by which the struggle was lost. The additional wound tokens are assigned one at a time by the losing player.

name: Horrid Dreams
Text: Action: Discard the top card of an opponent's deck. Then, that player must choose and sacrifice a card from the same faction if able.

name: In an Unmarked Grave
Text: Action: Each player sacrifices all non-unique characters he controls.

name: Inconspicuous Zoog
Text: Response: After you drain a domain to which Inconspicuous Zoog is attached as a resource, unattach Inconspicuous Zoog from that domain and attach it to a story card. (Counts as an ATTACHMENT ZOOG support card with the text: "Count Inconspicuous Zoog's skill and icons at attached story each time it resolves. If you win this story, return Inconspicuous Zoog to your hand.")

name: John Henry Price
Subtitle: Cold and Paternal
Text: Reduce the cost for you to play ATTACHMENT support cards on John Henry Price by 1. Response: After you play an Attachment support card on John Henry Price, draw 1 card.

name: Kaman-Thah
Subtitle: Priest of the Dreamlands
Text: If you control Nasht, Kaman-Thah gains +3 skill, and # $.

name: Keeper of Dreams
Subtitle: Mind Breaker
Text: Action: Exhaust Keeper of Dreams to choose a character. That character loses WILLPOWER until the end of the phase unless its controller discards 1 card at random from his hand.

name: King Kuranes
Subtitle: Ruler of Celephais
Text: Response: After you succeed at a story at which King Kuranes was committed, choose a DREAMLANDS support card controlled by an opponent and take control of that card.

name: Laboring Gug
Text: Response: After Laboring Gug is wounded, draw 1 card.

name: Magah Bird
Text: Response: After Magah Bird enters play, search your deck for a character named Magah Bird and put it into your hand.

name: Mi-Go Dreams
Text: Action: Return any number of MI-GO characters from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Midnight Rendezvous
Text: Action: Destroy all DAY cards, then attach Midnight Rendezvous to a story. Counts as an ENVIRONMENT support card with the text: "NIGHT. It is NIGHT. % struggles do not resolve at this story."

name: Mnomquah
Subtitle: The Moon God
Text: If it is NIGHT, Mnomquah is unaffected by all story and conspiracy card effects. Response: After you succeed at a story card to which Mnomquah is committed, discard an opponent's success token from that story.

name: Mnomquah's Serpent
Text: Play only if it is NIGHT. Action: Attach Mnomquah's Serpent to a character. Counts as a Curse attachment with the text: "NIGHT. Attached character cannot commit to stories. Attached character's controller must randomly discard a card from his hand at the end of each of his turns."

name: Moon-Beast Captain
Text: If you control more DREAMLANDS support cards than any opponent, reduce the cost to play Moon-Beast Captain by 2.

name: Moon-Beast Galley
Text: If you control more DREAMLANDS support cards than any opponent, ready all Dreamer characters at the beginning of each player’s turn.

name: Nasht
Subtitle: Priest of the Dreamlands
Text: If you control Kaman-Thah, Nasht gains +3 skill and @ %.

name: Nathaniel Elton
Subtitle: Questing for Cathuria
Text: Action: Exhaust a HEROIC character you control to choose and exhaust a VILLAINOUS character.

name: Night Class
Text: Play only if it is not DAY. Action: Put a { character with at least 1 $ icon into play from your hand. At the end of the phase, return that character to your hand if it is still in play.

name: Night Raid!
Text: Disrupt: Cancel the effects of a NIGHT card just played. Then, shuffle that card back into its owner's deck.

name: Night-shift Security
Text: If it is NIGHT, each character you control cannot be chosen as the only target of an event card.

name: Nightmares!
Text: Play only if it is NIGHT. Action: Choose a character. That character goes insane, if able. Otherwise, return it to the top of its owner's deck.

name: Nyarlathotep
Subtitle: The Black Pharaoh
Text: During the resource phase, if an opponent wishes to attach a resource to a domain, the resource must be chosen at random from his hand. (Choose the domain first, then randomly determine the resource.)

name: Obsessive Insomniac
Text: Action: Discard a resource from a domain you control to ready Obsessive Insomniac. Action: Exhaust Obsessive Insomniac to draw one card.

name: Petty Thief
Text: Response: After an opponent draws a card as the result of a card effect, exhaust Petty Thief to discard 1 card at random from that player's hand if that player has more cards in hand than you.

name: Price Manor
Text: Action: Exhaust Price Manor to take the topmost ATTACHMENT support card in your discard pile and add it to your hand.

name: Princess Zura
Subtitle: The Flower of the Charnel Garden
Text: Response: After an opponent's character leaves play, ready Princess Zura. Then, draw a card.

name: Prize Pistol
Text: Attach to an _ character. Attached character gains #. Action: Exhaust Prize Pistol and pay 1 to choose and wound one character with lower skill than the number of # icons attached character has.

name: Puj-Dunk
Subtitle: Gug Chieftain
Text: Response: After Puj-Dunk is wounded, put a GUG character into play from your hand.

name: Raking the Pot
Text: Response: After an opponent plays a character, that opponent must immediately drain another domain or return that character to his hand.

name: Randolph Carter
Subtitle: King of Ilek-Vad
Text: Randolph Carter gains TOUGHNESS +1 for each DREAMLANDS support card you control. Disrupt: Pay 3 to resolve an additional skill check (immediately after the initial skill check) at any story to which Randolph Carter is committed. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Richard Upton Pickman
Subtitle: Venerable Ghoul
Text: Richard Upton Pickman gains the icons of each attached GHOUL character. If Richard Upton Pickman would be wounded, you may discard an attached GHOUL character instead. Action: Pay 2 to attach a GHOUL character to Richard Upton Pickman from your hand or discard pile.

name: Ritual Initiation
Text: Action: Choose a unique } character. Until the end of the phase that character gains #, +1 skill, and TOUGHNESS +1. Then, you may pay 1 to return Ritual Initiation to your hand.

name: Secretive Zoog
Text: Response: After you drain a domain to which Secretive Zoog is attached as a resource, unattach Secretive Zoog from that domain and put it into play to choose one other ZOOG card you control. Attach that card to any of your domains (counts as a resource).

name: Shuggob, Ghoul Sage
Text: It is NIGHT. Discard all DAY cards from play after you play Shuggob from your hand.

name: Sleep Therapist
Text: Action: Exhaust Sleep Therapist to choose and ready a DREAMER character.

name: Slime Mold
Text: Action: Sacrifice Slime Mold to wound all wounded characters.

name: Stealthy Zoog
Text: Response: After you drain a domain to which Stealthy Zoog is attached as a resource, unattach Stealthy Zoog from that domain and attach it to a story. (Counts as an ATTACHMENT ZOOG support card with the text: "If attached story is won. its effect must resolve.")

name: Sweet Dreams...
Text: Play only if it is NIGHT. Action: Until the end of the phase, @ icons do not protect characters from insality.

name: The Back Room
Text: Each player draws 1 additional card during his standard draw phase action.

name: The Book of Black Stones
Text: Attach to a character you control. Action: Exhaust the Book of Black Stones to discard the top card of each player's deck.

name: The Captain
Subtitle: Dreamlands Navigator
Text: Action: If it is DAY, pay 2 to choose a story. Until the end of the phase, count The Captain's icons and skill towards that story without committing him to that story.

name: The Cats of Ulthar
Text: Action: During the Story phase, pay 3 to put The Cats of Ulthar into play from your hand, committed to a story of your choice. Action: Pay 1 to destroy 1 ZOOG card in play. Then, return The Cats of Ulthar to your hand.

name: The Cavern of Flame
Subtitle: Gateway to the Dreamlands
Text: If you control more DREAMLANDS support cards than any opponent, The Cavern of Flame gains: "Action: Exhaust The Cavern of Flame to choose a non-DREAMER character committed to a story. Ready that character, and remove it from the story."

name: The Dark Side of the Moon
Text: If it is NIGHT, the cost to play The Dark Side of the Moon is 0. Response: After an opponent wins a story card, each player chooses a character controlled by one of his opponents. Shuffle all chosen characters back into their owner's decks.

name: The Day Dreamer
Text: After The Day Dreamer comes into play, destroy all NIGHT cards. Action: Pay 2 to put The Day Dreamer into play from your hand. If The Day Dreamer is still in play at the end of the phase, sacrifice it.

name: The Enchanted Wood
Text: If you control more DREAMLANDS support cards than each individual opponent, @ icons do not protect characters from insanity.

name: The Light Side of the Moon
Text: If it is DAY, the cost to play The Light Side of the Moon is 0. Response: After an opponent wins a story card, each player chooses up to  3 characters he controls. Shuffle all characters not chosen back into their owner's decks.

name: The Night
Subtitle: Darkness Incarnate
Text: If it is Night, treat all exhausted non-unique, non-Night, characters as if their printed text boxes were blank.

name: The Rays of Dawn
Subtitle: Cleansing Light
Text: After The Rays of Dawn comes into play, destroy all NIGHT cards. Each non-unique character loses a @ icon.

name: The Setting Sun
Subtitle: The Light Fails
Text: After The Setting Sun comes into play, Destroy all DAY cards. Each non-unique character loses an % icon.

name: The Seven Hundred Steps
Subtitle: Of Deeper Slumber
Text: If a player has 2 story cards in his won story pile, that player's characters enter play exhausted. Action: Pay 2 to sacrifice The Seven Hundred Steps.

name: The Seventy Steps
Subtitle: Of Light Slumber
Text: If a player has no story cards in his won story pile, that player's characters enter play exhausted. Action: Pay 2 to sacrifice The Seventy Steps.

name: The Silver Key
Subtitle: Unlocking the way...
Text: Attach to a story card. Readied characters cannot commit to attached story. Exhausted characters can commit to attached story. Forced Response: After a character commits to attached story, ready that character.

name: The Sleep of the Dead
Text: Play at the end of your story phase. Action: Choose up to 2 characters. Those characters do not refresh during the next refresh phase.

name: The Tower of Koth
Subtitle: Passage to the Underworld
Text: Response: After you succeed at a story, exhaust The Tower of Koth to choose and wound 1 MONSTER character.

name: The Vale of Pnath
Text: If you control more DREAMLANDS locations than each opponent, The Vale of Pnath gains: "Disrupt: When an icon struggle resolves, exhaust The Vale of Pnath to cancel the game effects of that struggle."

name: The White Ship
Subtitle: Smooth and Silent
Text: Action: Exhaust The White Ship to choose a character you control that is committed to a story. Until the end of the phase, that character gains +2 skill and FAST. If you succeed at that story, search your deck for a DREAMLANDS support card, reveal it to your opponent, and add it to your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: The Woman of His Dreams
Text: Response: After The Woman of His Dreams is readied as the result of an $ struggle, choose and ready a non-ANCIENT ONE character.

name: Twila Katherine Price
Subtitle: Lost in a Dream
Text: If it is NIGHT, Twila Katherine Price gains: "Action: Exhaust Twila Katherine Price and pay 2 to resolve the effect of the story card to which Twila Katherine Price is committed."

name: Twila Katherine Price
Subtitle: Queen of Unknown-Kadath
Text: Response: After you succeed at a story at which Twila Katherine Price is committed, exhaust Twila Katherine Price to look at each opponent's hand, and choose 1 card to discard from those hands.

name: Twilight Cannibal
Text: If it is DAY, sacrifice Twilight Cannibal.

name: Twilight Gate
Text: Action: Choose a non-ANCIENT ONE character card attached to one of your domains as a resource. Put that card into play under your control. If that character is still in play at the end of the phase, attach it to any of your domains as a resource.

name: Twilight Ritual
Text: Action: Until the end of the phase, treat all DAY and all NIGHT cards currently in play as if their text boxes were blank. Then, draw a card.

name: Unknown Kadath
Subtitle: Home of the Other Gods
Text: Action: Exhaust Unknown Kadath to choose an opponent. That opponent must choose a DAY or NIGHT card in your discard pile and return it to your hand.

name: Victoria's Protege
Text: Forced Response: After Victoria's Protege comes into play, return 1 ] character to its owner's hand.

name: Wandering Gug
Text: Response: After Wandering Gug is wounded, discard the top from any player's deck.

name: Ward Phillips
Subtitle: Obsessed Recluse
Text: After an opponent wins a story card, sacrifice Ward Phillips. Disrupt: Exhaust Ward Phillips to cancel the effects of a character ability that has just been triggered.

name: Zoog Burrow
Text: Response: After you draw a ZOOG character, exhaust Zoog Burrow to reveal that card to each opponent and attach it as a resource to one of your domains. Then, you may immediately drain that domain to draw 1 card.
